description: What a voice answer to an approval request is worth. Each case gives the learner's transcript, the model's answer_approval input, and seenAtPress, false when no card had shown the request's whole summary for a second at the press and true when the case leaves it out, and says what the check keeps: null when the learner's own words do not support the answer, or the answer. harness/voiceapproval_test.go and leanring-buddyTests/VoiceApprovalTests.swift both read this file, so the Go check and the Swift check (leanring-buddy/VoiceApprovals.swift) cannot differ while both exist. Delete it with the Swift copy.

cases.name: a bare yes allows once
an upper case yes allows once
sure, go ahead allows once
yes please allows once
go ahead and do it allows once
the phrase do it alone is a yes
the phrase all right alone is a yes
alright is a yes
allow that, thanks is a yes
a yes with only filler words around it
a yes followed by a question is not a yes
cases.transcript: okay, what is this video about

cases.name: a yes with a word outside the answer is not a yes
a no word cancels a yes word
a curly apostrophe still reads as don't
don't allow it is not a yes
a thank you alone is not a yes
an empty transcript is not a yes
a combining mark keeps a word out of the vocabulary
always allow it allows always
a bare always is a yes with always
an always the learner did not say is refused
a bare no declines
a no with a reason declines
a no with always set stays a plain no
a no needs no check against the words, since declining is always safe
a call with no approved field answers nothing

a yes before the summary was read is refused

a no with always set before reading stays a plain no
